title: Loan Administration Standard for Whole Life Insurance: Interest Due Date, Repayment and Excess Indebtedness
content:
On every Ashgrove tier of Whole Life Insurance, policy loan interest falls due on the anniversary, repayments may be made while coverage continues, and excess indebtedness can end the policy.

## Clauses in force

- **Interest due date.** Loan interest for the policy year is due on the anniversary.
- **Order of a repayment.** A repayment is applied first to the interest accrued since the loan interest paid-to date and then to principal.
- **Smallest repayment.** A repayment must be at least the tier's smallest loan repayment, unless it repays the whole indebtedness.
- **Timing.** Repayment may be made at any time while the policy has coverage.
- **Excess indebtedness.** When the loan balance plus accrued interest equals or exceeds the guaranteed cash value plus the paid-up additions cash value, Ashgrove mails a default notice to the owner and to any assignee. The policy terminates for excess indebtedness when the tier's loan default notice period in calendar days has passed after the notice without a payment bringing indebtedness below that value.

## Retired clauses

Two former clauses of this standard are **no longer in force**:

1. the clause under which interest not paid by the anniversary is capitalized into the loan principal on that anniversary and itself bears interest; it is superseded by the current Ashgrove basis for billing anniversary loan interest and capitalizing it when unpaid, and for settling loan indebtedness inside a surrender payment;
2. the clause under which a loan is extinguished against the policy values on surrender, death, the application of a nonforfeiture option or loan default; it is superseded by the current Ashgrove basis for loan offsets against the policy values.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

| Indebtedness (loan balance plus accrued interest) | Guaranteed plus additions cash value | Default notice |
|---|---|---|
| 20000.00 | 20000.00 | Mailed: equality is enough |
| 19999.99 | 20000.00 | Not mailed |

- A repayment of 1000.00 when 140.00 of interest has accrued since the loan interest paid-to date pays the 140.00 of interest first and 860.00 of principal.
- On a tier whose smallest repayment is 50 dollars, a repayment of 35.00 is accepted only where 35.00 is the whole indebtedness.

superseded_clauses: interest not paid by the anniversary is capitalized into the loan principal on that anniversary and itself bears interest
A loan is extinguished against the policy values on surrender, death, the application of a nonforfeiture option or loan default.
